Subject: Urgent: Possible data exposure — request for IR artifacts and retention clarification

Hi Markus,

We observed suspicious outbound activity from a NovaNet integration using your API keys late yesterday (Aug 17). Our security team flagged several unexpected GETs that returned customer identifiers. We're treating this as a potential data exposure.

Can Redwood please:  
- Confirm whether this activity originated from your production infrastructure;  
- Provide an evidence snapshot (logs, request traces, relevant KV cache metadata) for the 17:00–23:00 UTC window on Aug 17;  
- Tell us how long Redwood will retain those artifacts and the process for secure transfer.

We need an initial response within 24 hours for our incident timeline. Kevin Chu (legal) is on copy for any contractual/retention questions.

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Security Operations
NovaNet Financial

Alicia / Kevin —
Following up to confirm the status and provide commitments: 

1) Evidence transfer: bundle delivered to your SFTP (single-use account). Custody manifest and hashes are included.
2) Retention: Redwood will retain a copy of the encrypted forensic bundle for 30 days by default. If NovaNet requires longer retention up to 180 days, we can arrange that under an evidence escrow addendum; please confirm.
3) Deletion attestation: once NovaNet confirms successful ingestion, Redwood will schedule secure deletion and provide a deletion certificate (signed) within 5 business days of the purge.

We can also execute a short DPA amendment or an evidence-escrow SOW if your legal team prefers a formal attachment. I included Neha to coordinate the compliance paperwork.

Next steps:
- Alicia: confirm if you want 30d default or extended (specify # days).
- Kevin / legal: indicate whether a DPA amendment or a standalone SOW is preferred; I can share a draft this afternoon.

Thanks — and please reach out if you need additional artifacts (heap dumps or decrypted traces) — those require a signed access request.

Markus Klein
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
